svg.desc: Both methods start from the same preference pairs. RLHF trains a separate reward model, then loops: sample from the policy, score with the reward model, update with PPO plus a KL penalty - four models in memory. DPO keeps only the policy and a frozen reference model and optimises a single logistic loss over the pairs directly.

svg.text: Two ways to learn from preferences

svg.text: Same data. DPO removes the reward model and the RL loop.

svg.text: The reward model does not get simpler in DPO - it disappears. Algebra lets the policy's own log-probs

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stand in for it, which turns the whole problem into supervised classification over pairs.
